name: Göncruszka (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of red and green triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Göncruszka (a blue shield with a figure and a bunch of grapes, with a helm and mantling, within a green wreath) below the words KÖZSÉGI ÖNKORMÁNYZAT in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
